summary: Kalra Family Law has a clean, scannable layout, Book Online and Book Now buttons, and a team of lawyers. Visible typos, a mismatched address and no client proof hold back a firm that clients must trust in a hard moment.

findings.problem: Visible typos: ensure the your child's best interests are protected, and Book a free consulation for a custom will. The informal line don't charge silly fees also sits on a legal page.
findings.cost: A family law firm sells care and precision. Typos on the page clients read first weaken both.
findings.fix: A proofread build with a consistent, professional tone.

findings.problem: The Google review link points to 425 University Ave suite 300, while the contact section lists 55 University Avenue, Suite 1100.
findings.cost: A client who cannot tell which address is right may go to the wrong place, and a mismatch makes the firm look disorganised.
findings.fix: One verified address across the site and your Google profile.

findings.problem: No client testimonials or case results appear, and the trust badges are images with no visible ratings. The four process steps have blank titles.
findings.cost: Family law clients choose on trust. Unrated badges and blank process steps do not give them a reason to pick you.
findings.fix: Named reviews, visible ratings and a clear four step process.

findings.problem: The Book a Free Consultation button repeats many times, and there is no contact form, chat or WhatsApp. Social icons have no labels.
findings.cost: Clients who will not call or book online have no other way to reach you, and repeated buttons dilute the main action.
findings.fix: One primary button, a short intake form and a chat or WhatsApp option.

redesign: A consultation first homepage with one clear button, a short intake form and a phone number above the fold.
Proof beside every button: named reviews, ratings and your team.
Practice area pages written to rank for searches like divorce lawyer Toronto and child custody lawyer Toronto.
